job_description:
Sales Representative

We are looking for an energetic Sales Representative for our retail and B2B channels.

Responsibilities
- Drive sales and hit monthly revenue targets
- Prospecting and lead generation for new business development
- Deliver excellent customer service and build long-term client relationships
- Negotiate pricing and close deals
- Track pipeline in CRM / Salesforce
- Support merchandising, point of sale and inventory

Requirements
- Must have: Sales and Customer Service experience
- 2+ years of sales experience
- High school diploma required; Bachelor's degree preferred
